name: agentic-game-dev-claude-plugin
description: Claude Code plugins for agentic game development. This repo is only an index: each plugin lives in its own repository.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Build, fix and verify Godot 4.7 games headlessly: a godot-game-builder subagent with a bundled skill, dispatcher tools, linting, scripted scenarios and exports.

plugins.name: unity-headless-cli
plugins.description: Set up a Unity project to be driven headless from the terminal, with no GUI and no MCP server: create GameObjects, edit assets, run tests and evaluate C#.
